note: Big Sur's largest campground, in coast redwoods along the Big Sur River in three camps (South, Weyland and Main). Trailers to 27 ft. Many pads are under 23 ft; the booking site lists each site's pad length. Fills six months ahead, even in winter. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov park + camping pages, ReserveCalifornia (all 190 units' details) and imagery read. Open again since 26 Nov 2026 (flood closure; Timber Fire trail closures remain). 189 sites, motorhome 32 / trailer 27 ft, no public hookups, flush toilets, token showers, dump with water. $50 standard / $60 premium riverfront (unchanged). 48-h cutoff, day-of sites only from cancellations, 7-night peak limit, max 6 people (state row says 8). Waterfront: riverfront -> creekside proposed (river creek-size). Pin move proposed (~1 km).
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront -> creekside proposed (stored value is not --AWH). The Big Sur River at the campground is creek-size: imagery shows only a ~20-25 m bare gravel bar by South Camp (36.2433,-121.7765), the wetted channel is hidden under redwood canopy and fog over Weyland and Main camps, and nothing seen approaches the ~30 m riverfront line. Imagery is canopy-blind, so the sites themselves can't be measured; the per-site evidence is ReserveCalifornia's 'Proximity to Water: Riverfront' tag on 30 premium units sold nightly at $60 - RV-capable ones with 23 ft+ pads: SC60 (28 ft), SC63 (32), SC66 (32), SC69 (25), W093 (23), W114 (27), W116 (30), W130 (23), P179 (24), P181 (32), P183 (23), P185 (23), P186 (32); shorter riverfront pads: SC59, W090, W095, W112, W113, W123, W127-W129, P171, P174, P175, P177 (16-22 ft); W118, W120, P133, P189 are admin sites. With 13+ bookable 23-ft+ sites tagged on the river, creekside clearly holds. Suggested evidence: 'ReserveCalifornia 2026-11-27: 30 premium units tagged Riverfront ($60), incl. SC60/63/66/69, W093/114/116/130, P179/181/183/185/186 with 23-32 ft pads; Esri: canopy, river bar ~20-25 m by South Camp -> creek-size -> creekside.'
